comment: Retention policy for BlackHorse memory. Disk-first; RAM is only a tiny cache.

permanent.comment: NEVER auto-deleted. Lessons, rules, trade outcomes, key decisions, digests, performance.

ephemeral.comment: MUST be deleted after TTL. Raw observations, debug snapshots, transient signals (7 days).

raw_jsonl.comment: Raw append-only files on disk. Gzip when old, delete when ancient.

sqlite.comment: Tune for DISK, not RAM. Negative cache_size = kibibytes.
